candidates.teaser: Mercury goes retrograde in 9 days — and most people won't see it coming until it's too late.
candidates.video_title: Mercury Retrograde Hits in 9 Days — Are You Ready?
candidates.video_description: Mercury stations retrograde on October 24 in Scorpio, and the shadow effects are already building. With five planets already retrograde, this one tips the scale. Here's what to watch for now.
candidates.script: Nine days. That's all you have before Mercury goes retrograde in Scorpio — October 24th. And here's what nobody's telling you: five planets are already retrograde right now, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto — Mercury will make it six. Scorpio rules secrets, obsession, and things buried alive. When Mercury stations here, conversations you thought were dead come crawling back. Back up everything. Sign nothing major. Which area of your life can't afford a rewind?

candidates.topic: Waxing Crescent Moon in Sagittarius — Fire Under Scorpio Season
candidates.teaser: There's a Sagittarius Moon cutting through all this Scorpio intensity right now — and it's pulling you in two opposite directions.
candidates.video_title: Sagittarius Moon vs. Scorpio Season — Pick a Side
candidates.video_description: Today's Waxing Crescent Moon sits at 21° Sagittarius while the Sun, Mercury, and Venus all crowd Scorpio. The tension between truth-seeking fire and emotional depth is real. Here's how that plays out.
candidates.script: Right now the Moon is in Sagittarius — the sign that wants freedom, adventure, and blunt honesty — while the Sun, Mercury, and Venus are all buried deep in Scorpio's shadows. That's fire trying to burn through water. The Waxing Crescent phase means something new is still forming, still fragile. This is the tension between what your soul craves and what your wounds are demanding. Which one are you actually listening to?

candidates.topic: Mars Conjunct Jupiter in Leo — Last Call
candidates.teaser: Two of the most powerful planets just collided in Leo — and the window to use that energy is almost closed.
candidates.video_title: Mars and Jupiter in Leo — Last Chance to Use This Fire
candidates.video_description: Mars sits at 10° Leo and Jupiter at 22° Leo — they're both in the same fire sign while most of the sky is in retrograde chaos. This is the one loud, forward-moving energy in an otherwise locked-down sky.
candidates.script: While five planets are spinning backward, Mars and Jupiter are both charging through Leo — and that combination is the loudest energy in the sky right now. Mars at 10°, Jupiter at 22°, same sign, same fire. Astrologers call this a rare ignition point: ambition, visibility, bold action. But Leo energy doesn't wait. It performs or it fades. Five retrograde planets will try to slow you down. The question is whether you move anyway.

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — The Discipline Paradox Explained
candidates.teaser: Saturn is retrograde in the most impulsive sign of the zodiac — and that combination is quietly dismantling your sense of who's in charge of your life.
candidates.video_title: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Who's Really in Control?
candidates.video_description: Saturn retrograde in Aries asks a brutal question: are the rules you live by actually yours, or did someone else hand them to you? This is one of the most psychologically intense transits of 2026.
candidates.script: Saturn retrograde in Aries is one of the most uncomfortable transits you can have — because Saturn wants structure and rules, and Aries wants to burn every rule to the ground. In astrology, when Saturn goes retrograde, the authority it represents turns inward. You stop asking what the world expects and start facing what you actually built. And in Aries, that question gets brutal fast: is your ambition really yours, or just borrowed pressure from someone else?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 2nd House — Money, Self-Worth, and What You Cling To
candidates.teaser: The 2nd house isn't really about money — it's about what you believe you deserve, and that changes everything.
candidates.video_title: The 2nd House — It's Not About Money. It's Deeper.
candidates.video_description: Most people think the 2nd house is your bank account. Astrologers say it's actually your sense of self-worth made material. What you earn, spend, and keep reveals what you think you deserve.
candidates.script: Everyone says the 2nd house is about money — and they're only half right. In astrology, the 2nd house is your self-worth made visible. What you own, what you earn, what you refuse to let go of — it all reflects what you believe you deserve at the core level. The sign on your 2nd house cusp and any planets sitting inside it reveal your deepest relationship with value itself. Not what's in your account — what you think you're worth.
